law.catch_line: False statement or representation in applications for eligibility or for use in determining rights to benefits; concealment of facts; criminal penalty

text.section: It shall be the duty of the Director of Medical Assistance Services or his designee to enforce the provisions of this section. A warrant or summons may be issued for violations of which the Director or his designee has knowledge. Trial for violation of this section shall be held in the county or city in which the application for medical assistance was made or obtained.
